flowchart TD
    %% Styles
    classDef rhino fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
    classDef gh fill:#ff9,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
    classDef math fill:#bbf,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
    classDef output fill:#bfb,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
    Start([Start: Define Beam Geometry]):::rhino
    subgraph Geometry_Definition ["1. Define Beam Geometry"]
        direction TB
        G1[Create Base Profile (2D Curve)]:::math
        G2[Create Beam Length (Line/Tube)]:::math
        G3[Join Profile & Length]:::rhino
    end
    subgraph Import ["2. Import to Grasshopper"]
        direction TB
        I1[Open Grasshopper]:::gh
        I2[Import Rhino File (.3dm)]:::gh
        I3[Verify Geometry Integrity]:::math
    end
    subgraph CrossSection ["3. Define Cross Section"]
        direction TB
        C1[Select Profile Curve]:::gh
        C2[Define Extrusion Direction]:::math
        C3[Set Extrusion Length]:::math
    end
    subgraph Extrusion ["4. Perform Extrusion"]
        direction TB
        E1[Use 'Extrude' Component]:::gh
        E2[Input Profile & Direction]:::gh
        E3[Input Length]:::gh
        E4[Generate 3D Solid]:::output
    end
    subgraph Cleanup ["5. Cleanup & Export"]
        direction TB
        K1[Remove Temporary Geometry]:::rhino
        K2[Check for Overlaps/Intersections]:::math
        K3[Export as .3dm or .obj]:::rhino
    end
    Start --> G1
    G1 --> G2
    G2 --> G3
    G3 --> I1
    I1 --> I2
    I2 --> I3
    I3 --> C1
    C1 --> C2
    C2 --> C3
    C3 --> E1
    E1 --> E2
    E2 --> E3
    E3 --> E4
    E4 --> K1
    K1 --> K2
    K2 --> K3
    K3 --> End([End: 3D Beam Model])
    class G1,G2,G3 rhino;
    class I1,I2,I3 gh;
    class C1,C2,C3 gh;
    class E1,E2,E3,E4 gh;
    class K1,K2,K3 rhino;
